thread:
maria_k: quick check — procurement pushed a PO to VendorX this morning for an eu-west1 A500 burst (~16 cards). Vendor says tentative delivery week of May 12. Can we confirm GCP quota bump will land before then? Need a short-term burst window until the dedicated pool is provisioned. :pray:

procure-bot: PO# VX-99214 created, status: submitted to vendor. ETA: vendor tentative May 12. Attached docs: https://vendorx.example.com/po/VX-99214

aj_s: which GCP project / billing account is this against? quota increases go to GA support + GCP sales for faster turnaround.

maria_k: project: redwood-prod-eu (billing acct: BA-772). Quotas needed: GPUs (A100/A500 family) x16 in eu-west1, and corresponding CPU/GPU quota for custom images. I started a support request but not yet created an escalation.

devon: FYI GCP quota increases usually 3-5 business days if straightforward. If vendor delivery is tight, we can patch with a small preemptible mix in another region, or ask vendor for holding inventory. Also: do we have validated images for A500? driver/kernel reqs differ.

leo_t: cross-region fallback adds network egress + latency. If this is for Dedicated testing rollout, prefer local region. How urgent is the burst?

maria_k: it's for Dedicated pool smoke tests + perf runs — timeline is fairly strict (need to validate autoscaler & perf before onboard). Urgency: high but not emergency, leaning toward proactive escalation.

aj_s: I can open a GCP escalation if you drop the support ticket ID here. Also can ping our account rep to push quota. Can someone confirm exact instance types (A500 model string) and images?

maria_k: instance type: a2-highgpu-1g (A500), but vendor will provide boards — we need equivalence for quota. Images: custom-llm-runtime:ubuntu22-cuda12.1 (we tested on A100 w/ CUDA12.1).

sre-oncall: note — onboarding A500 nodes required kernel module build + CUDA 12.1. Quick checklist I usually ask ops to verify after launch: 
```
ssh into node 
run: nvidia-smi -L 
check driver: cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version || cat /etc/nvidia/version 
validate CUDA: nvcc --version
```
If any of those fail, we should have AMI fallback ready.

procure-bot: Support ticket created: GCP-TKT-43821, priority: P2 (escalation pending). Vendor update queued for 2026-05-03.

maria_k: thanks all. @aj_s can you kick the GCP escalation now? @sre-oncall i'll DM you the image build artifacts and AMI fallback details. I'll also ask VendorX for a short holding agreement. :thumbsup:

aj_s: on it — pinging account rep and attaching GCP-TKT-43821 to the escalation. Will report back here.

devon: if escalation stalls, we should prepare a minimal test harness on preemptible A2s and note any perf delta. I'll draft a quick benchmark script tomorrow.

leo_t: noted. prepping network/egress cost estimate in case cross-region becomes necessary.

maria_k: perfect, appreciate it. I'll update once vendor confirms holding agreement or GCP confirms quota. :rocket:
